lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Independent application: inspection, documentation, and moving out

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic inspection, documentation, and moving out task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: In a fictional scenario, a person named Jordan is moving out of a fictional apartment at the end of the month.
safetyNotes: Jordan and the apartment are entirely fictional; the learner does not need to plan or document a real move to complete this lesson.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: What is one item on your checklist that would be easy to forget while packing under time pressure, and what would help make sure it doesn't get skipped?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each. | Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation. | Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write a short note Jordan could send along with the written documentation when returning the keys, referencing at least two specific checklist items.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic inspection, documentation, and moving out task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or notes app
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: In a fictional scenario, a person named Jordan is moving out of a fictional apartment at the end of the month.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact inspection, documentation, and moving out decision or action.
Model move 2: Before making the checklist, write your current understanding of a key distinction.
Model move 3: Build a room-by-room documentation checklist for Jordan's move-out.

Model check: Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each. | Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation. | Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for inspection, documentation, and moving out.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: In a fictional scenario, a person named Jordan is moving out of a fictional apartment at the end of the month.
Coach direction: Before making the checklist, write your current understanding of a key distinction.
Learner prompt: Before making the checklist, what do you think 'normal wear and tear' means, as opposed to damage a tenant would be charged for?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Build a room-by-room documentation checklist for Jordan's move-out.

Response 1 (t2-p1): For each of four areas -- kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, and the main living space -- write two or three specific things Jordan should check and note the condition of in writing before moving out.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: What is one item on your checklist that would be easy to forget while packing under time pressure, and what would help make sure it doesn't get skipped?

Success checks: Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each. | Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation. | Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional inspection, documentation, and moving out condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each. | Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation. | Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: inspection, documentation, and moving out — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the inspection, documentation, and moving out task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: What is one item on your checklist that would be easy to forget while packing under time pressure, and what would help make sure it doesn't get skipped?
observableCriteria: Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each.
Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation.
Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist specificity and completeness: All four areas are covered with at least two specific, verifiable items each. | Deposit-protection reasoning: Explanation clearly connects move-out documentation to protecting the deposit, using Jordan's situation. | Practical follow-through: Reflection names a specific item and a specific, workable plan to avoid skipping it.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g11-u04-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
